svg.text: The State of the Union got simpler
Reading-grade level of every spoken-era address, 1913–2026.
From college level to middle school
Average Flesch–Kincaid grade of each State of the Union, 1913 on (spoken/broadcast era).
Dashed = years with no address in the dataset. Y-axis: grade level.
Decade-average grade under four formulas (State of the Union, spoken era).
Sentences got less than half as long
Average words per sentence, State of the Union, by decade.
Shorter sentences are a large part of why the grade-level formulas fall.
Inaugural addresses slid too, with more noise
Flesch–Kincaid grade of each spoken-era inaugural (27 addresses), 1913–2025.
